en.title: Announcing a new course
en.excerpt: AUASS announces an online astronomy skills course for amateur astronomers and university and school students, led by trainer Dalal Allala, on 19–21 February 2023; places are limited.
en.body:
The Arab Union for Astronomy and Space Sciences announces

a specialised course for amateur astronomers, university students and school students.

#دورة_المهارات_الفلكية (Astronomy skills course)

Trainer: Dalal Allala

The course will run over three days, 19–21 February 2023.

https://forms.gle/CEsrUp4CbM484q989

- Places are limited

- The course is held online

#يسعدنا_تواجدكم ✨🚀❤️
